exercises.question: Which sentence makes a future prediction? [¿Cuál hace una predicción sobre el futuro?]
options: La tecnología seguirá cambiando. [Technology will continue changing.]
La tecnología cambió en el pasado. [Technology changed in the past.]
La tecnología cambia ahora. [Technology changes now.]

exercises.sentence: __ habrá nuevas formas de trabajar. (probably) [There will probably be new ways of working.]
exercises.english: There will probably be new ways of working.
It is likely that the situation will change.

sentences: Primero, la tecnología seguirá evolucionando. [First, technology will continue evolving.]
Después, habrá nuevas formas de trabajar. [Then there will be new ways of working.]
Finalmente, muchas personas trabajarán de otra manera. [Finally, many people will work differently.]

exercises.question: Which word means «trend»? [¿Qué palabra significa «tendencia»?]
options: tendencia [trend]
transformación [transformation]
desarrollo [development]

exercises.sentence: Es difícil __ exactamente lo que ocurrirá. (to predict) [It is difficult to predict exactly what will happen.]
exercises.english: It is difficult to predict exactly what will happen.
